title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
title_zh: 通过组合偏好与评分奖励实现前沿文本到图像模型的后续训练

paragraphs.en: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. In this work, we develop a simple and effective post-training recipe for open-domain text-to-image generation based on the composition of complementary reward signals. Our reward system consists of two main components: a preference reward, trained on large-scale human preference data using a Bradley–Terry objective to capture overall human aesthetic and perceptual preferences, and rubric-based rewards, which explicitly evaluate prompt faithfulness and other desirable properties while providing safeguards against reward hacking. A key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals. We show that a naive weighted average leads to suboptimal optimization behavior, and propose a simple reward composition strategy that more effectively balances preference optimization with rubric satisfaction. In the Arena text-to-image leaderboard 1 1 1 https://arena.ai/ , our RL-trained Flux2dev achieves an Elo rating 69 points above the base model, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 surpasses every open-source model on the leaderboard, reaching an Elo of 1223.5. 2 2 2 Claims of state-of-the-art performance are based on the Arena leaderboard snapshot as of September 4, 2026. Our results suggest that effective rewards for frontier generative-model training require broad coverage of user intent and robustness to exploitation under optimization. To support reproducible research, we release Arena-T2I-Training, a 1K subset of training data that recovers some gains of full-scale training, providing a resource that we hope will facilitate future work on post-training for text-to-image models. Project page: https://banyuanhao.github.io/Post-Training-Frontier-Text-to-Image-Models-by-Composing-Preference-and-Rubric-Rewards/ .

paragraphs.en: Modern text-to-image (T2I) generation models have made rapid progress in visual quality, prompt understanding, and compositional ability. As base models become increasingly capable, an important question is how to further improve them with post-training. Several methods such as DiffusionNFT [ 34 ] and Flow-GRPO [ 16 ] , have recently been developed for post-training T2I models, but their effectiveness critically depends on the rewards: open-domain image generation involves many aspects of quality that are difficult to capture with any single signal. Learned preference rewards such as PickScore [ 14 ] , HPSv2/v3 [ 31 , 20 ] , and ImageReward [ 32 ] are trained on human preference data and provide broad supervision for what users like. Complementing them, recent work has developed more targeted rewards for specific capabilities such as spatial reasoning, text rendering, and compositional correctness [ 29 , 19 ] . However, naively combining these rewards does not necessarily improve performance, as poorly designed reward functions may fail to fully capture the desired behavior and can be hacked by the model.
paragraphs.zh: 现代文本到图像（T2I）生成模型在视觉质量、提示理解和构图能力方面取得了快速进展。 随着基础模型的能力不断增强，一个重要的问题是如何通过后训练进一步改进它们。 近期已开发出多种用于 T2I 模型后训练的方法，例如 DiffusionNFT [ 34 ] 和 Flow-GRPO [ 16 ]，但它们的有效性在很大程度上取决于奖励机制：开放领域的图像生成涉及许多质量方面，而这些方面难以通过单一信号完全捕捉。 像 PickScore [ 14 ]、HPSv2/v3 [ 31 , 20 ] 和 ImageReward [ 32 ] 这类学习到的偏好奖励是基于人类偏好数据训练的，为用户偏好的内容提供了广泛的监督。 作为补充，近期的研究已开发出针对特定能力的更精准奖励，例如空间推理、文本渲染和构图正确性 [ 29 , 19 ]。 然而，简单粗暴地结合这些奖励并不一定能提升性能，因为设计不当的奖励函数可能无法完全捕捉期望的行为，甚至可能被模型“利用”。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we develop a simple yet effective recipe for post-training modern open-domain T2I models by composing preference and rubric rewards. The preference term is a Bradley–Terry (BT)-based reward model trained on large-scale human preference data. While several existing reward models can serve this role, we find that scaling up the number of preference pairs yields further gains, and accordingly train ours on ∼ 5 \sim 5 million pairwise human preference votes collected from Arena. Preference supervision alone, however, is insufficient: it captures broad aspects of human preference such as aesthetics, yet remains largely blind to properties that are sparse or weakly represented in pairwise votes, such as faithfully including every requested object or satisfying prompt-specific constraints. Indeed, as shown in Fig. 5 , when we directly optimize FLUX.2-dev [ 4 ] against either our independently trained Arena reward model or the publicly available PickScore [ 14 ] , the optimized reward continues to increase, while the actual quality quickly saturates and then degrades.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过组合偏好奖励和评分标准奖励，为现代开放领域的文本到图像（T2I）模型开发了一种简单而有效的训练后优化方案。 偏好项是一个基于 Bradley–Terry（BT）模型的奖励模型，该模型在大规模人类偏好数据上进行了训练。 尽管已有多种奖励模型可以承担这一角色，但我们发现，增加偏好对的数量能带来进一步的提升，因此我们在 Arena 平台上收集了约 500 万条成对的人类偏好投票，并以此训练我们的模型。 然而，仅靠偏好监督是不够的：它虽然能捕捉到人类偏好的广泛方面（如美学），但对那些在成对投票中稀疏或表现较弱的特点（例如忠实包含所有请求的物体或满足特定提示的约束条件）却基本无法识别。 事实上，如图 5 所示，当我们直接针对我们独立训练的 Arena 奖励模型或公开可用的 PickScore [14] 优化 FLUX.2-dev [4] 时，优化后的奖励值持续上升，而实际图像质量却迅速达到饱和，随后甚至出现下降。

paragraphs.en: We address this limitation by complementing the broad preference signal with a set of open-ended, prompt-conditioned rubric rewards , each designed to capture a distinct aspect of generation quality or failure mode. First, a faithfulness reward explicitly evaluates whether the generated image contains the content and satisfies the requirements specified in the prompt [ 2 ] . Second, an intent-gated constraint reward penalizes unsupported additions when literal adherence to the prompt is desired. Finally, to mitigate reward hacking, we introduce rubric-based hack detectors that identify known undesirable behaviors emerging during optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将宽泛的偏好信号与一组开放式的、受提示词条件约束的评价标准奖励相结合，来解决这一局限性；其中每一项奖励都旨在捕捉生成质量或失败模式的某个特定方面。 首先，一个忠实度奖励会明确评估生成的图像是否包含提示词中指定的内容，并满足其要求 [ 2 ] 。 其次，一个意图门控约束奖励会在需要严格遵循提示词时，对任何未经支持的内容添加进行惩罚。 最后，为了缓解奖励操纵问题，我们引入了基于评价标准的操纵检测器，用于识别优化过程中出现的已知不良行为。

paragraphs.en: Another key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals effectively. Our design consists of four components. First, we normalize each reward component to a common [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale before aggregation [ 17 ] , reducing sensitivity to differences in their native scales. Second, we develop hack detectors that identify exploits of the preference reward. Rather than treating their outputs as additional additive terms, we use them to suppress the positive preference reward associated with the detected exploit; this prevents the policy from gaining reward merely by learning to satisfy the detectors. This prevents the policy from gaining reward merely by learning to satisfy the detector. Furthermore, to reduce interference among competing reward signals, we introduce a gating mechanism that determines when individual rewards are active. Finally, we find that different reward configurations exhibit complementary strengths and failure modes. Therefore, we ensemble independently optimized policies directly in weight space by averaging their LoRA deltas [ 30 ] . Together, these design choices yield a robust reward ensemble that generalizes well across settings and substantially reduces the need for burdensome hyperparameter tuning.

paragraphs.en: Using this composed reward, we develop a post-training recipe that consistently improves already-strong T2I models under real-world human evaluation. paragraphs.en: Text-to-image post-training uses several kinds of reward signals. Learned preference models such as ImageReward [ 32 ] , PickScore [ 14 ] , and HPSv2/v3 [ 31 , 20 ] train scalar predictors from large-scale human comparisons of images, while UnifiedReward [ 28 ] uses a unified VLM judge for both image understanding and generation quality. Other rewards target narrower notions of quality: perceptual scorers such as the LAION aesthetic predictor [ 23 ] evaluate visual quality without explicitly measuring prompt adherence, while verifiable rewards measure specific capabilities programmatically, such as GenEval’s detector-based object checks [ 6 ] , OCR-based text-rendering rewards [ 16 ] or dependency-aware faithfulness rewards [ 2 ] . We study two rewards from the learned-preference family: PickScore itself, used directly as a training objective, and an arena reward model trained on millions of pairwise human votes collected continuously from production models under real user prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像的后训练过程使用多种奖励信号。 已学习的偏好模型，例如 ImageReward [ 32 ]、PickScore [ 14 ] 和 HPSv2/v3 [ 31 , 20 ]，通过大规模的人类图像比较来训练标量预测器，而 UnifiedReward [ 28 ] 则使用统一的 VLM 裁判来评估图像理解和生成质量。 其他奖励则针对更狭窄的质量概念：感知评分器（如 LAION 美学预测器 [ 23 ]）评估视觉质量时并未明确测量对提示的遵循程度，而可验证的奖励则通过编程方式测量特定能力，例如 GenEval 基于检测器的对象检查 [ 6 ]、基于 OCR 的文本渲染奖励 [ 16 ] 或依赖感知的忠实度奖励 [ 2 ]。 我们研究了已学习偏好模型家族中的两种奖励：直接用作训练目标的 PickScore 本身，以及一个在真实用户提示下从生产模型中持续收集的数百万条人类成对投票上训练的竞技场奖励模型。

paragraphs.en: Rubric-based rewards decompose open-ended human preferences into explicit evaluation criteria, thereby extending reinforcement learning objectives from verifiable domains to more open-ended settings [ 7 ] . OpenRubrics [ 18 ] derives rubrics by contrasting preferred and rejected responses, while AutoRule [ 27 ] uses chain-of-thought prompting on preference pairs to extract candidate evaluation rules. Autorubric-T2I [ 13 ] further learns rule weights and selects discriminative criteria using ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -regularized logistic regression on image preference data, yielding an interpretable rubric-based reward model. Chasing the Tail [ 33 ] iteratively sharpens rubrics to distinguish among top-performing responses. Auto-Rubric [ 25 ] uses information-theoretic global compression to distill a compact, non-redundant set of reusable evaluation criteria from limited preference data.
paragraphs.zh: 基于评分标准的奖励机制将开放式的偏好分解为明确的评估标准，从而将强化学习的目标从可验证的领域扩展到更具开放性的场景 [ 7 ]。 OpenRubrics [ 18 ] 通过对比受青睐和受拒绝的响应来生成评分标准，而 AutoRule [ 27 ] 则利用对偏好对的链式思维提示来提取候选评估规则。 Autorubric-T2I [ 13 ] 进一步通过基于图像偏好数据的 ℓ₁ -正则化逻辑回归学习规则权重并选择具有区分度的标准，从而生成一个可解释的基于评分标准的奖励模型。 Chasing the Tail [ 33 ] 通过迭代优化评分标准，以区分表现最佳的响应。 Auto-Rubric [ 25 ] 利用信息论中的全局压缩方法，从有限的偏好数据中提炼出一套紧凑且无冗余的可重复使用的评估标准。

paragraphs.en: The faithfulness reward measures whether the content requested by the prompt is correctly realized in the generated image. Several algorithms for this have been proposed in the literature to decompose each prompt into a dependency-aware set of yes/no questions [ 11 , 5 , 2 ] . Here we adopt the same methodology from Arena-T2I-Hard [ 2 ] which uses an LLM to decompose the prompt into a tree-structured checklist offline. A VLM judge answers the applicable questions, and the faithfulness reward is defined as the fraction answered positively. This signal is presence-oriented: it evaluates whether requested objects, attributes, relations, and styles are present and correctly realized. In practice, we use gemini-3-pro-preview to decompose our training prompts, yielding 182 182 k questions over 10 10 k prompts. We use Qwen3.6-27B as our VLM judge. Prompt templates, statistics, and a worked example are provided in Sec. A.3.2 .

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, we introduce a complementary absence-oriented constraint reward that discourages content inconsistent with the user’s intent. Using the same VLM-based checklist framework as the faithfulness reward, we construct questions that check whether the generation satisfies constraints on undesirable or extraneous content. These constraints include explicit negative instructions, restrictions on background, style, or additional objects, as well as implicit requirements inferred from the user’s intent. For example, given a prompt requesting a minimalist image, introducing unnecessary or unrequested elements may violate the intended simplicity even though no such element is explicitly prohibited. In practice, the constraint checklist for each prompt is generated offline by a single call to gemini-3.1-pro-preview , yielding 26 26 k constraint questions over the 10 10 k training prompts. Each question is phrased so that a “yes” answer indicates compliance, and the constraint reward is the fraction of questions answered “yes” by the same Qwen3.6-27B judge during training. Additional details are provided in Sec. A.3.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们引入了一种互补的、以缺失为导向的约束奖励机制，用以抑制与用户意图不一致的内容。 与忠实性奖励采用相同的基于 VLM 的检查清单框架，我们构建了一系列问题，用于检验生成内容是否满足对非必要或多余内容的约束要求。 这些约束包括明确的负面指令、对背景、风格或额外对象的限制，以及从用户意图中推断出的隐含要求。 例如，对于一个要求生成极简主义图像的提示，引入不必要的或未请求的元素可能会违背预期的简洁性，即使这些元素并未被明确禁止。 在实际操作中，每个提示的约束检查清单通过单次调用 gemini-3.1-pro-preview 离线生成，从而在 10,000 个训练提示中获得了 26,000 条约束问题。 每个问题的表述方式都使得“是”的回答表示符合约束，而约束奖励则是在训练期间由同一 Qwen3.6-27B 评判模型回答“是”的问题所占的比例。 更多细节请参见第 A.3.3 节。

paragraphs.en: To prevent the policy from exploiting loopholes in the reward model, we introduce rubric-based anti-reward-hack rewards that target known reward-hacking behaviors. Depending on the nature of the failure mode, we consider two general classes of anti-reward-hack rewards:
paragraphs.zh: 为防止策略利用奖励模型中的漏洞，我们引入了基于评分标准的反奖励操纵奖励机制，以针对已知的奖励操纵行为。 根据失效模式的不同性质，我们考虑了两种广义的反奖励操纵奖励类型：

sents.en: To prevent the policy from exploiting loopholes in the reward model, we introduce rubric-based anti-reward-hack rewards that target known reward-hacking behaviors.
sents.zh: 为防止策略利用奖励模型中的漏洞，我们引入了基于评分标准的反奖励操纵奖励机制，以针对已知的奖励操纵行为。

sents.en: Depending on the nature of the failure mode, we consider two general classes of anti-reward-hack rewards:
sents.zh: 根据失效模式的不同性质，我们考虑了两种广义的反奖励操纵奖励类型：

paragraphs.en: When a failure can be evaluated from a single generated image, we use a pointwise anti-reward-hack reward that directly checks whether the output exhibits the corresponding undesirable behavior. This form is appropriate for criteria that admit an approximately absolute notion of correctness and therefore do not require comparison with a reference generation. For example, we observe that some reward models can encourage the generation of unrequested garbled text. As malformed text can be identified directly from a single image, this failure is naturally captured by a pointwise anti-reward-hack reward.
paragraphs.zh: 当一次失败可以通过单张生成的图像进行评估时，我们使用逐点反奖励机制的奖励函数，直接检查输出是否表现出相应的不良行为。 这种形式适用于那些可以近似地定义绝对正确性概念的标准，因此无需与参考生成结果进行比较。 例如，我们观察到某些奖励模型可能会鼓励生成未请求的乱码文本。 由于格式错误的文本可以直接通过单张图像识别出来，这种失败自然会被逐点反奖励机制的奖励函数所捕捉到。

paragraphs.en: For failures defined by an undesirable drift of the policy relative to the base model, we instead use reference-based anti-reward-hack rewards that compare the policy output against a generation from the frozen base model for the same prompt. Such comparisons make the direction of the policy shift explicit and assess whether the policy output exhibits stronger evidence of the undesirable behavior than the reference. For example, we observe a tendency toward excessive photorealism even for prompts that explicitly request a cartoon style. However, from a single image alone, it can be difficult to determine whether the degree of photorealism is excessive. By comparing the policy output with a frozen-base generation for the same prompt, the detector can more reliably identify whether the policy has shifted further toward photorealism. A reference-based anti-reward-hack reward is therefore better suited to capturing this type of relative failure. To mitigate position bias, each pair is judged in both presentation orders. All detector verdicts are produced by the same Qwen3.6-27B judge used for the checklist rewards. The verbatim detector questions and their arming conditions are listed in Sec. A.3.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于因策略相对于基础模型出现不希望的变化而定义失败的情况，我们转而使用基于参考的反奖励机制，该机制将策略输出与针对相同提示词由冻结的基础模型生成的结果进行比较。 此类比较使策略变化的方向变得明确，并能评估策略输出是否比参考结果表现出更强烈的不希望行为迹象。 例如，我们观察到即使提示词明确要求卡通风格，模型仍存在过度追求照片级真实感的倾向。 然而，仅凭单张图像，可能很难判断照片级真实感的程度是否过于夸张。 通过将策略输出与针对相同提示词由冻结基础模型生成的结果进行比较，检测器能够更可靠地识别策略是否进一步向照片级真实感偏移。 因此，基于参考的反奖励机制更适合捕捉这类相对性失败。 为缓解位置偏差，每对样本都会以两种呈现顺序进行判断。 所有检测器的判定结果均由与检查表奖励相同的 Qwen3.6-27B 判官模型生成。 检测器的逐字问题及其激活条件列于第 A.3.5 节中。

paragraphs.en: The reward signals described above operate are heterogeneous: they are defined on different native scales, and each captures a distinct aspect of generation quality. Naively summing them can lead to interference among reward components, yielding an aggregate reward that is unstable and difficult to optimize. To address this issue, we introduce three key mechanisms: reward-decoupled normalization, prompt-conditioned gating, and a veto-based anti-reward-hack prevention.
paragraphs.zh: 上述描述的奖励信号是异构的：它们定义在不同的原始尺度上，且各自捕捉生成质量的独特方面。 简单地将它们相加可能导致奖励各成分之间产生干扰，从而得到一个不稳定且难以优化的综合奖励。 为解决这一问题，我们引入了三种关键机制：解耦奖励的归一化、提示条件化的门控机制，以及基于否决权的反奖励操纵预防机制。

Normalizing each axis independently, rather than the summed reward, prevents differences in reward scale from causing any single component to dominate the combined optimization objective, thereby improving training stability.

paragraphs.en: Not every reward signal is meaningful for every prompt. In particular, constraint-based rewards may be inappropriate for prompts that allow substantial creative freedom. Consider, for example, the prompt “create an image of a country road in an Impressionist style.” Adding elements such as a woman or flowers is a legitimate creative choice rather than a violation of the user’s intent, so applying the constraint reward indiscriminately would penalize valid generations and unnecessarily restrict the model’s generation space. The anti-reward-hack rewards are prompt-dependent in the same way. For example, a tendency toward photorealism is not undesirable when the prompt explicitly requests a photorealistic image, yet the same tendency is a failure when the prompt requests a cartoon style. We therefore introduce prompt-conditioned applicability gates for both the constraint reward and the anti-reward-hack rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 并非每个奖励信号对每个提示都是有意义的。 特别是，基于约束的奖励可能不适用于允许较大创作自由的提示。 例如，考虑提示“以印象派风格创作一条乡村道路的图片”。添加女性或花朵等元素是合理的创作选择，而非违背用户意图的行为，因此不加区分地应用约束奖励会惩罚有效的生成结果，并不必要地限制模型的生成空间。 反奖励操纵奖励在这一点上同样依赖于具体提示。 例如，当提示明确要求照片级真实图像时，倾向于照片级真实并非坏事；但当提示要求卡通风格时，同样的倾向则是一种失败。 因此，我们为约束奖励和反奖励操纵奖励引入了基于提示的条件适用性机制。

paragraphs.en: We sample training and validation prompts from the distribution of real user prompts in Arena leaderboard. We found RL is more sensitive to data quality than the RM training. So we use a stricter system prompt with gemini-3.5-flash to filter the prompt pool more aggressively, removing image-editing requests, under-specified one-line prompts, prompts centered on niche named entities, and non-English prompts. This process yields 10k training prompts and 1k validation prompts. More details on the prompt filter are provided in Sec. A.2.2 , together with an early controlled comparison in which training on the unfiltered prompt pool degrades substantially faster under the same reward.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Arena 排行榜中真实用户提示的分布中采样训练和验证提示。我们发现，与 RM 训练相比，RL 对数据质量更为敏感。因此，我们使用 gemini-3.5-flash 配合更严格的系统提示，对提示池进行更激进的筛选，移除图像编辑请求、描述不充分的单行提示、以小众命名实体为核心的提示以及非英语提示。该过程最终获得了 10,000 条训练提示和 1,000 条验证提示。关于提示过滤器的更多细节见第 A.2.2 节，其中还包含一项早期的受控对比实验：在相同奖励机制下，使用未经过滤的提示池进行训练会导致性能下降速度显著加快。

paragraphs.en: We adopt two frontier text-to-image foundation models as our base model: FLUX.2 [dev] [ 4 ] and Ideogram 4 [ 12 ] . FLUX.2 [dev] is a 32B-parameter rectified-flow transformer with a hybrid multimodal DiT architecture, comprising 8 double-stream blocks that jointly model text and image features while maintaining modality-specific representations, followed by 48 single-stream blocks operating on the concatenated token sequence. It uses Mistral Small 3.1 [ 21 ] for text conditioning. In contrast, Ideogram 4 is a 9.3B-parameter flow-matching model built on a fully single-stream, 34-layer DiT, where text and image tokens are jointly processed throughout the network. It uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] as its text encoder and demonstrates strong capabilities in prompt following, typography, and text rendering. Currently in Arena Leaderboard, Ideogram 4 is the open source Text-to-image generative model #1.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用两款前沿文本到图像基础模型作为我们的基础模型：FLUX.2 [dev] [ 4 ] 和 Ideogram 4 [ 12 ]。 FLUX.2 [dev] 是一款拥有 320 亿参数的修正流变换器，采用混合多模态 DiT 架构，包含 8 个双流块，可联合建模文本和图像特征，同时保持各模态的特定表示；其后是 48 个单流块，用于处理拼接后的令牌序列。 它使用 Mistral Small 3.1 [ 21 ] 进行文本条件约束。 相比之下，Ideogram 4 是一款拥有 93 亿参数的流匹配模型，基于完全单流的 34 层 DiT 构建，文本和图像令牌在整个网络中都会被联合处理。 它使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] 作为文本编码器，并在提示遵循、排版和文本渲染方面展现出强大能力。 目前在 Arena Leaderboard 上，Ideogram 4 是排名第一的开源文本到图像生成模型。

sents.zh: 我们采用两款前沿文本到图像基础模型作为我们的基础模型：FLUX.2 [dev] [ 4 ] 和 Ideogram 4 [ 12 ]。

sents.en: FLUX.2 [dev] is a 32B-parameter rectified-flow transformer with a hybrid multimodal DiT architecture, comprising 8 double-stream blocks that jointly model text and image features while maintaining modality-specific representations, followed by 48 single-stream blocks operating on the concatenated token sequence.
sents.zh: FLUX.2 [dev] 是一款拥有 320 亿参数的修正流变换器，采用混合多模态 DiT 架构，包含 8 个双流块，可联合建模文本和图像特征，同时保持各模态的特定表示；其后是 48 个单流块，用于处理拼接后的令牌序列。

sents.en: It uses Mistral Small 3.1 [ 21 ] for text conditioning.
sents.zh: 它使用 Mistral Small 3.1 [ 21 ] 进行文本条件约束。

sents.en: In contrast, Ideogram 4 is a 9.3B-parameter flow-matching model built on a fully single-stream, 34-layer DiT, where text and image tokens are jointly processed throughout the network.
sents.zh: 相比之下，Ideogram 4 是一款拥有 93 亿参数的流匹配模型，基于完全单流的 34 层 DiT 构建，文本和图像令牌在整个网络中都会被联合处理。

sents.en: It uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] as its text encoder and demonstrates strong capabilities in prompt following, typography, and text rendering.
sents.zh: 它使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] 作为文本编码器，并在提示遵循、排版和文本渲染方面展现出强大能力。

sents.en: Currently in Arena Leaderboard, Ideogram 4 is the open source Text-to-image generative model #1.
sents.zh: 目前在 Arena Leaderboard 上，Ideogram 4 是排名第一的开源文本到图像生成模型。

paragraphs.en: We use DiffusionNFT [ 34 ] as our optimizer. For Flux.2[dev], each step samples G = 48 G{=}48 prompt groups and generates K = 24 K{=}24 rollouts per prompt using 10 sampling steps at 512 2 512^{2} resolution with CFG 4.0 4.0 . For every run, we evaluate checkpoints 30 , 60 , 90 , 120 , 150 {30,60,90,120,150} on the 1 1 k Arena validation set and report the best-performing checkpoint. paragraphs.en: Our method consists of three stages. In Stage 1, we combine the preference, faithfulness, and intend-gated constraint rewards and train an initial post-trained model. In Stage 2, we analyze the reward-hacking failure modes exhibited by the best Stage 1 checkpoint, design corresponding anti-reward-hack rewards, and train a second model with these additional signals. In Stage 3, we combine the best checkpoints from Stages 1 and 2 through weight-space model souping to obtain the final model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法包含三个阶段。 在阶段 1 中，我们将偏好性、忠实度和意图门控约束奖励相结合，并训练一个初始的后训练模型。 在阶段 2 中，我们分析阶段 1 的最佳检查点所表现出的奖励破解失败模式，设计相应的反奖励破解奖励，并利用这些额外信号训练第二个模型。 在阶段 3 中，我们通过权重空间模型融合将阶段 1 和阶段 2 的最佳检查点相结合，以获得最终模型。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , we audit 205 205 failure cases of the best Stage 1 checkpoint and identify two recurring reward-hack modes: (i) garbled or unrequested rendered text, and (ii) photo-style drift, where the policy replaces an explicitly requested non-photographic style with cinematic photorealism. We therefore introduce targeted rubric-based detectors that identify these exploits during training and prevent them from being reinforced. Combining the new anti-reward-hack reward, our Stage 2 checkpoint is comparable to the previous one.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，我们审计了最佳第一阶段检查点的 205 个失败案例，并识别出两种重复出现的奖励漏洞模式：(i) 混乱或未被请求的渲染文本；以及 (ii) 照片风格漂移，即策略将明确请求的非照片风格替换为电影级的超真实主义。 因此，我们引入了基于评分标准的定向检测器，用于在训练期间识别这些漏洞，并防止它们被强化。 结合新的反奖励漏洞奖励机制，我们的第二阶段检查点与之前的版本相当。

paragraphs.en: We continues to merge the model weight of our best Stage 1 checkpoint and the Stage 2 checkpoint. It is motivated by the fact that the two parent runs exhibit complementary behavior despite achieving similar aggregate win rates. On the 1k validation prompts, Stage 1 checkpoint has 204 204 clear losses against the base model, while the gated-veto run has 234 234 , with only 92 92 losses shared between them. Their wins also concentrate in different categories: the no-hack-prevention Stage 1 run performs particularly well on composition ( 65 % 65\% ) and style ( 16 % 16\% ), whereas the hack-prevention Stage 2 run achieves relatively more wins through faithfulness ( 16 % 16\% vs. 9 % 9\% ) and clean text rendering ( 9 % 9\% vs. 3 % 3\% ). As shown in Tab. 2 , the resulting model improves the Gemini win rate to 0.6598 0.6598 with Arena RM and 0.6256 0.6256 with PickScore, outperforming both parent models. Per-prompt analysis further shows that the soup retains complementary strengths from both parents: Stage 3 wins on 0.560 0.560 and 0.397 0.397 of the Stage 1’s and Stage 2’s exclusive loss sets, respectively, and still achieves a 0.304 0.304 win rate on prompts where both parents lose. paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 qualitatively illustrates the same progression observed in the quantitative results. First optimizing a single preference reward leaves visible failure modes: arena-only training tends to drift toward generic embellishment and sometimes misses requested content. Arena-T2I-Hard combines the preference reward with a faithfulness reward and better recovers the requested elements. However, it might encourage the model to over-satisfy the prompt by inserting extra objects that make the required concepts easier to recognize, which can make the rendered image cluttered and less preferred. As shown in the second row of Fig. 1 , the prompt asks for children’s toys to appear only as ghostly shapes formed by steam rising from a forgotten cup of tea, but the Arena-T2I-Hard model additionally materializes a solid wooden toy horse on the table. Applying the constraint reward uniformly removes some of these additions, but can also over-correct. As seen in the first row of Fig. 1 , while the ungated constraint reward removes undesirable decorations, it also suppresses benign background details, collapsing the background into a flat white field. In contrast, in our Stage 1 run, we apply constraints only when the user calls for strict adherence, producing images that better preserve the requested content and style while avoiding unnecessary additions. These examples qualitatively mirror the improvements observed in the quantitative results.

paragraphs.en: We investigate how the amount of preference data used to train the reward model affects downstream RL performance. Specifically, we use intermediate checkpoints of our Arena RM trained on ∼ 10 {\sim}10 K, ∼ 100 {\sim}100 K, and ∼ 500 {\sim}500 K pairwise human preference votes, apply the same Stage 1 RL recipe to each checkpoint, and evaluate the resulting models using MMRBv2 win rate against the frozen base model. As shown in Fig. 3 , RL performance improves as the amount of RM training data increases: the win rate rises from 0.537 0.537 with 10K preference pairs to 0.607 0.607 with 100K and 0.611 0.611 with 500K, while the full ∼ 5.6 {\sim}5.6 M-pair RM achieves 0.642 0.642 . These results indicate that scaling human preference data for reward-model training translates into consistent gains in downstream RL performance.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Tab. 1 , post-training establishes a new state of the art among open models on the live LMArena text-to-image leaderboard. paragraphs.en: We presented a simple and effective recipe for post-training open-domain text-to-image models, built on the composition of complementary reward signals: a Bradley–Terry preference reward trained on large-scale human votes, and open-ended, prompt-conditioned rubric rewards that captures prompt faithfulness, intent-conditional constraints and detectors for emerging hack modes. Furthermore, we introduce four mechanism to intergate the reward, making it robustness to optimization and generalize well. The resulting recipe reliably improves already-strong base models under live human evaluation: our RL-trained FLUX.2-dev gains 69 69 Elo points over its base model on the LMArena text-to-image leaderboard, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 reaches an Elo of 1223.5 1223.5 , surpassing every open-source model on the leaderboard. We believe this composition principle offers a scalable path for post-training future frontier generative models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种简单而有效的训练后开放域文本到图像模型的方法，该方法基于互补奖励信号的组合：一种通过大规模人类投票训练的 Bradley–Terry 偏好奖励，以及能够捕捉提示忠实度、意图相关约束和新兴“漏洞模式”检测器的开放式、提示条件化的评分奖励。 此外，我们引入了四种机制来整合奖励信号，使其对优化过程更具鲁棒性，并具备良好的泛化能力。 在真实人类评估中，该方法可靠地提升了原本已表现出色的基础模型：我们的强化学习训练版 FLUX.2-dev 在 LMArena 文本到图像排行榜上比其基础模型获得了 69 个 Elo 积分，而我们的训练后 Ideogram-4 则达到了 1223.5 的 Elo 积分，超越了排行榜上的所有开源模型。 我们相信，这一组合原则为未来前沿生成模型的训练后优化提供了一条可扩展的路径。

paragraphs.en: Photometric augmentation is applied to every training image inside the collator, after aspect-ratio correction: brightness, contrast, and saturation jitter of ± 0.05 \pm 0.05 each, hue shift of ± 0.025 \pm 0.025 , and additive Gaussian pixel noise at σ = 0.005 \sigma{=}0.005 on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] -scaled pixels, applied to every training image.

paragraphs.en: The training-prompt filter is gemini-3.5-flash under a fixed yes/no rubric: a prompt is kept only if it describes a single renderable image, is predominantly visual description, depends on no external image or hidden context, does not hinge on niche named-entity knowledge, is fluent English, and carries enough visual detail to support a vivid image.
paragraphs.zh: 训练提示词过滤器采用 gemini-3.5-flash，并遵循固定的“是/否”评判标准：仅当提示词满足以下条件时才会被保留——它描述的是单张可渲染的图像，以视觉描述为主，不依赖任何外部图像或隐藏上下文，不依赖于小众的命名实体知识，使用流畅的英语表达，并且包含足够的视觉细节以生成生动的图像。

paragraphs.en: The system prompt given to gemini-3.5-flash to validate candidate RL training prompts; a prompt is kept only if the model answers yes .

paragraphs.en: We train Stage 1 model with Arena RM on both 100 100 k unfiltered arena prompts and our 10 10 k filtered arena prompts, and use the same judge protocol with GEMINI. The run trained on the unfiltered pool lost to its filtered counterpart by 0.0360 0.0360 . We therefore read the gap as lower-quality prompts degrading training under the same optimization pressure, and adopt filtered prompt sets throughout the paper.

paragraphs.en: A single decomposition call per prompt to gemini-3-pro-preview produces atomic yes/no questions with an explicit dependency DAG. The system prompt enforces: each question checks exactly one visual attribute like object existence, color, count, spatial relation, action, style, and text content; every detail of the prompt is covered, ordered from core subjects to minor stylistic details; nothing the prompt does not mention or imply may be asked about; existence questions are DAG roots, attribute questions depend on their object’s existence question, and relation questions depend on both objects’ existence. The split carries 182,230 182{,}230 faithfulness questions with its mean as 18.2 18.2 per prompt, median as 17 17 , and max as 70 70 . At training time the judge answers the DAG level-by-level in batched yes/no calls; a question whose parent failed is scored “no” without being asked, and the reward is the fraction of questions answered “yes”.
paragraphs.zh: 每次提示词对 gemini-3-pro-preview 仅调用一次分解，即可生成具有明确依赖 DAG 的原子级“是/否”问题。 系统提示词强制要求：每个问题仅检查一个视觉属性，如物体存在性、颜色、数量、空间关系、动作、风格和文本内容；提示词的每一个细节都涵盖在内，且按从核心主体到次要风格细节的顺序排列；提示词未提及或未暗示的内容不得被提问；存在性问题为 DAG 的根节点，属性问题依赖于其对应物体的存在性问题，而关系问题则同时依赖于两个物体的存在性问题。 该拆分包含 182,230 个忠实度问题（182{,}230），每个提示词的平均值为 18.2（18.2），中位数为 17（17），最大值为 70（70）。 在训练阶段，评判器以分层的“是/否”调用方式逐层回答 DAG；若某个问题的父问题失败，则该问题无需提问即被计为“否”，而奖励值为回答“是”的问题所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: A offline call per prompt to gemini-3.1-pro-preview does two things at once. First it classifies the prompt’s openness to unrequested additions: strict when the prompt closes the spec, open when a short or evocative prompt invites embellishment, and neutral in between; it also extracts a style_lock indicating a named style that must be preserved, a background_spec , and a coarse detail budget. Second, it writes the constraint checklist strict prompts get one question per explicit negative, a background check, a style-preservation check, and always the generic catch-all “Is the image free of prominent objects, scenery, or decorative details that the prompt did not request?” ; neutral prompts get only constraints explicitly stated in the prompt; open prompts get none. Label distribution: 3,140 3{,}140 strict / 4,443 4{,}443 neutral / 2,405 2{,}405 open / 12 12 failure; 26,213 26{,}213 constraint questions in total. Constraint questions are phrased so that “yes” means compliant and are scored by the same yes/no judge as the faithfulness checklist.
paragraphs.zh: 每次提示向 gemini-3.1-pro-preview 发起的一次离线调用会同时执行两项任务。 首先，它会判断提示对未经请求的补充内容的开放程度：当提示明确限定范围时，判定为严格；当简短或富有启发性的提示鼓励添加细节时，判定为开放；介于两者之间则判定为中立。同时，它还会提取一个 style_lock，表示必须保留的指定风格，以及一个 background_spec 和一个粗略的细节预算。 其次，它会生成约束检查清单：对于严格提示，每出现一个明确的否定要求就提出一个问题，此外还包括背景检查、风格保留检查，以及通用的兜底问题“图像中是否没有提示未要求的显著物体、场景或装饰性细节？”；对于中立提示，仅包含提示中明确提出的约束；对于开放提示，则不包含任何约束。 标签分布：严格提示 3,140 / 中立提示 4,443 / 开放提示 2,405 / 失败案例 12；共提出 26,213 个约束问题。 约束问题的措辞使得回答“是”表示符合约束，并且这些问题与忠实度检查清单由相同的“是/否”判断器进行评分。

paragraphs.en: The Ideogram-4 runs add a graded OCR axis, targeting Ideogram’s text-rendering emphasis. For each training prompt, the text spans the prompt explicitly asks to be rendered like quoted strings and named text elements are extracted once and stored as prompt metadata. During training, we use a VLM to transcribe all visible text in the image without seeing the prompt , and each expected span receives 0.5 ⋅ exact + 0.3 ⋅ partial + 0.2 ⋅ recall 0.5\cdot\mathrm{exact}+0.3\cdot\mathrm{partial}+0.2\cdot\mathrm{recall} , where exact indicates the span appearing verbatim as a substring of the transcription, partial is a fuzzy string-similarity score, and recall is the fraction of the span’s tokens recovered anywhere in the transcription; the sample’s OCR reward is the mean over its spans. Prompts that request no text, and samples whose transcription call fails, are excluded from the axis rather than penalized. The axis enters with weight 1.0 1.0 under the same per-batch z-normalization as the other axes.
paragraphs.zh: Ideogram-4 运行添加了一个分级 OCR 轴，旨在强化 Ideogram 的文本渲染能力。 对于每个训练提示，提示中明确要求的文本范围会被提取出来，其中引号内的字符串和命名的文本元素会被提取一次并存储为提示元数据。 在训练过程中，我们使用一个 VLM 来转录图像中所有可见的文本，而无需查看提示；每个预期文本范围将获得 0.5 ⋅ 精确匹配 + 0.3 ⋅ 部分匹配 + 0.2 ⋅ 召回率 0.5\cdot\mathrm{exact}+0.3\cdot\mathrm{partial}+0.2\cdot\mathrm{recall}，其中“精确匹配”表示该文本范围作为子串完全出现在转录结果中，“部分匹配”是一个基于字符串相似度的模糊评分，“召回率”则是该文本范围中任意位置被正确恢复的标记比例；样本的 OCR 奖励值是其所有文本范围的平均值。 要求不包含任何文本的提示，以及转录调用失败的样本，会被排除在该轴之外，而非受到惩罚。 该轴以 1.0 的权重加入，并与其他轴采用相同的每批 z-归一化方法。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks and reward models typically emphasize only one or a few dimensions of generation quality, and therefore may not fully capture overall user preference in real-world settings; this motivates the pairwise LLM-as-a-judge protocol. For each prompt the judge receives the two generated images, the original user prompt, and a fixed evaluation rubric, and selects the better generation; to reduce position bias, each image pair is evaluated twice with the presentation order reversed and the verdicts aggregated. The canonical FLUX.2 protocol renders the 1k Arena validation prompts. Both the evaluated checkpoint and the frozen base generate from prompts expanded at inference time by gemini-3.5-flash with FLUX.2’s and Ideogram 4’s official message. The judge receives the original, unrewritten user prompt on both sides.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准和奖励模型通常只关注生成质量的单一或少数几个维度，因此可能无法完全捕捉真实场景中的整体用户偏好；这促使了“成对 LLM 作为裁判”协议的产生。 对于裁判收到的每个提示，系统会提供两张生成的图像、原始用户提示以及固定的评估标准，裁判需从中选出更优的生成结果；为减少位置偏差，每对图像会被评估两次，每次交换展示顺序，最终将两次判断结果汇总。 标准的 FLUX.2 协议会渲染 1k Arena 验证提示。 被评估的检查点与冻结的基础模型均基于通过 gemini-3.5-flash 在推理时扩展的提示进行生成，并采用 FLUX.2 和 Ideogram 4 的官方消息格式。 裁判在两侧都会收到原始、未经改写过的用户提示。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate our reward design on the 791 public MMRBv2 T2I test prompts [ 10 ] , using the same checkpoint selected on the arena validation set and prompt rewriting. None of these prompts are used for training, reward tuning, or checkpoint selection. As shown in Tab. 6 , the main trends observed on our primary evaluation set transfer to this external benchmark. Moreover, Stage 3 again achieves the highest win rate at 0.6011 0.6011 , and the ablation orderings are preserved. paragraphs.en: We attribute this trade-off to the use of a single holistic preference score.
